delete.description: Deletes a client account and its refresh tokens and outbound scans. Its pick entries are deleted with their stock restored, and its claimed orders are released.

get.description: Returns usernames and scopes for all client accounts. Password hashes are never serialized.

schema.title: Response Get Users Admin Users Get

post.description: Creates a client-scope account. This is how operator accounts are created when self-registration is disabled (production).

Revokes every session of a client account: its access and refresh tokens stop working on the next request and its WebSocket connections are closed. Each device returns to its login screen; the password is unchanged.
Sets a new password, revokes all of the user's sessions (tokens stop working on the next request) and closes their WebSocket connections, so every device must log in again.
Authenticates credentials only when the account has the admin scope.

429.description: Too many failed attempts for this username; retry later

post.description: Ends the refresh token's session: its access and refresh tokens stop working at once and its WebSocket connections are closed.
Consumes a stored refresh token and returns a replacement token pair.
